notes: Credentials come from CS_URL, CS_KEY and CS_SECRET. Never put them here.
Only healer-ubuntu has a port forward. The healer reaches app instances
over the internal network, so the loop runs on healer-ubuntu, not on the laptop.
Baseline snapshot 645a5c25-2842-4b68-9152-8395c61466d1 is kept as an
independent recovery reference and is not used for experiment resets.
The lab host enforces a startup storage requirement: nginx has an
ExecStartPre preflight that fails when the bounded log filesystem has too
little free space. That is a deliberate lab protocol, not stock nginx
behaviour: nginx rolls back a failed reload and keeps serving.
